decisions.reason: Meaning, heroic tone, two-line structure, and natural Vietnamese are preserved without terminology conflicts.

decisions.proposed_text: Marvelous!\nĐầy năng lượng, bất khả chiến bại, thay đổi cả thế giới!
decisions.reason: Current second line has unnatural Vietnamese syntax around vô địch. Revision preserves the energetic and invincible adverbial characterization while staying idiomatic.

decisions.proposed_text: May mắn ơi, đến đây nào!\nCô gái mê bói toán, luôn cầu vận may
decisions.reason: Phúc ơi is a stiff literal personification in Vietnamese. Revision naturally conveys both the call for good fortune and the fortune-praying, divination-loving characterization.

decisions.proposed_text: Không gì có thể trói buộc!\nMã Nương hoạt bát, mộc mạc và chân thành
decisions.reason: Current text uses forbidden generic Uma Musume and has a stiff first line. Revision preserves the free-spirited characterization and required project world term.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.world.umamusume requires generic 赛马娘 → Mã Nương and forbids Uma Musume outside the franchise title.

decisions.reason: Faithful and natural rendering of the wish to become more positive and the hardworking-but-pessimistic characterization.
